title: 怪物意图随机 / Monster Intent Randomizer
description:
[h2]功能[/h2]
按怪物画像随机生成开场状态和招式。怪物各有行动预算、攻击频次和招式偏好。随机意图会在行动前显示，指定的召唤、阶段转换等关键招式沿用原版。

[list]
[*] 设置 → 常规 → 怪物意图随机 · 设置。用两个滑动条调整全局行动力和混沌，改动自动保存。
[*] 完整设置可以编辑逐怪画像和状态估值，并按种子模拟招式。
[/list]

[h2]注意事项[/h2]
[list]
[*] 适配《杀戮尖塔 2》v0.113 系列。订阅后在游戏的模组列表中启用，并重启游戏。
[*] 单人设置从下一场战斗生效。联机各端需使用同一版模组，进房时采用主机建房时的战斗设置。主机改动设置后请重新建房。
[*] 从手动安装版切换到工坊版时，请先退出游戏并移走游戏 mods 目录里的旧版同名文件夹。和其他改写怪物招式或开场状态的模组同时使用时，效果可能相互影响。
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
Randomizes opening effects and moves using each monster's action budget, attack frequency, and move preferences. Random intents are shown before the monster acts. Selected scripted moves, such as summons and phase transitions, retain their original behavior.

[list]
[*] Open Settings → General → Monster Intent Randomizer · Settings. The Global Action Power and Chaos sliders save automatically.
[*] Advanced Settings lets you edit monster profiles and effect values and run seeded combat simulations.
[/list]

[h2]Before playing[/h2]
[list]
[*] For Slay the Spire 2 v0.113.x. Subscribe, enable the mod in the game's mod list, and restart.
[*] Solo changes take effect next combat. In co-op, everyone needs the same build, and players receive the host's settings from when the lobby was created. Recreate the lobby after changing the host's settings.
[*] When switching from a manual installation, exit the game and move the old MonsterIntentRandomizer folder out of the game's mods directory. Mods that also change monster moves or opening effects may interact with this one.
[/list]

[h2]GitHub 源码与使用说明 / Source and documentation[/h2]
[url=https://github.com/x-J-beta/MonsterIntentRandomizer]x-J-beta/MonsterIntentRandomizer[/url]
changeNote:
v0.2.0
重算怪物基础行动力和部分状态估值。更新行动预算与偏好抽取，怪物共用战斗攻击预算，积存行动力可增加同回合出招。塞牌和部分持续减益按预计剩余战斗回合估值。逐怪设置和模拟可按怪物种类、地图筛选，部分怪物按攻击段数播放不同原版动画。联机各端请统一更新。

Recalibrated monster action budgets and several effect values. Monsters share an attack budget per combat, and a large action balance can add effects to a move. Card insertion and some lasting debuffs are valued using estimated remaining combat turns. Monster settings and simulation support roster filters, and selected monsters use different native animations for single and multiple hits. All co-op players should update to the same build.
